question: On exactly the 1,585 native median-cap VIX positions, how far could this fixed signal and exit family get if every originally planned order were filled immediately?
single_variable: For only the originally observed positive-cap parents, remove the initial historical trading-volume ceiling. Originally missing/nonpositive source reservations stay empty and are never backfilled. All original 12H signals, entry order, nine shared slots, cash conservation, 20% hourly single-name trim, native four-leg exits and 1x/2x exposure remain identical. Fee-only and extra 5bp. Compare matched 42,486U and 39,218U actually volume-limited simulations.
interpretation: This counterfactual prices unlimited immediate liquidity. It is neither a feasible execution claim nor a mathematical upper bound for alternative sizing, paths or future policies. Measure how many immediate fills would violate the original volume budget; compare directly to the 1,001,000U historical terminal target.
